Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 About the Role:
You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike is opening a new talent track for builders- senior engineers who take a feature from a rough idea to a production system on their own, and who use AI as a genuine multiplier rather than a buzzword. This isn’t a backfill for an existing seat. It’s a newly created role for someone who already operates autonomously and wants to keep doing that inside a company with real scale, real users, and daily production deployments. You take a high-level idea, figure out what actually needs to be built by talking to the right people, and ship it end-to-end: backend logic, frontend touches where needed, automated and manual testing, infra, and the dozen adjacent things a real feature needs. You read the existing codebase with judgment- reusing what’s solid, rebuilding what isn’t, and refusing to leave tech debt for the next person.
AI is not optional here. You’re expected to work AI-native: using it daily to move faster, and knowing when to push back when it suggests something that doesn’t hold up. If you’ve written your own automation, scripts, or internal tooling to remove friction from your own workflow, that’s exactly the instinct we’re hiring for.
Your Impact:

Take ambiguous, high-level product ideas and turn them into a concrete technical plan- by asking the right people the right questions, not waiting for a fully written spec
Designed, built, and shipped end-to-end features across the full stack- including a Java/Spring backend, REST APIs, data layer, testing, infrastructure touches, and rollout- while utilizing modern frontend technologies like TypeScript, React 19, Microfrontends, and Module Federation, alongside legacy Dart components.
Navigate a real, living codebase- deciding what to reuse, what to rebuild, and holding the line against unnecessary tech debt
Think in systems: anticipate second-order effects before they become incidents
Make technical and product tradeoff calls yourself, manage the risk, and push things over the finish line
Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude/Codex, our internal AI portal and MCP) as a daily part of how you build- including writing your own automations and skills where they save real time
Challenge AI output and product asks alike when they don’t hold up- critical thinking is part of the job, not a side skill

Your Qualifications:

Strong full-stack engineering experience, with deep comfort in Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, and SQL, TypeScript, React 19
A track record of owning features or systems end-to-end, not just executing a fully-specified ticket
Experience navigating and improving an existing, non-trivial codebase- this isn’t a greenfield role
Advanced, hands-on use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow- you’re past the learning curve already
Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the outcome, good or bad
Backgrounds we tend to see succeed here: technical founders, early engineers at startups who built the first version, small-company CTOs/Heads of Engineering, or senior engineers with active, recent open-source or side-project work

Our Stack:

Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, SQL
TypeScript, React 19, Redux, Dart
PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ
Unit/integration testing, Java web stack
AI tooling: Cursor, Claude/Codex, Zencoder, internal AI portal, internal MCP

Benefits & Perks:

28 calendar days of paid vacation
Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 
2 Volunteer Days
Health Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
Life Insurance Plan
Utility Allowance (30 EUR/month, subject to taxation)
Fitness Plan (800 EUR/year)
Full-remote & On-demand access to Co-working space

Interested in joining Wrike when the right opportunity opens up? Apply to our Senior Builder today. We’ll reach out as soon as a suitable role becomes available, or simply to arrange a Meet & Greet call.
Your recruitment buddy will be Alexander Chernev, Senior Recruiter.
#LI-AC1Who Is Wrike and Our Culture
We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
 

Hybrid work mode


Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
 
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.



Our persona 
💡  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. 
Our culture and Values 
🤩 Customer-Focused
We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.
🤝 Collaborative
We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.
🎨 Creative
We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. 
💪 Committed
We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.
 

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

WHAT WE DO

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.




WHO WE ARE

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.





WHO WE NEED

As Head of Accounting & Advisory Partnerships, you will lead one of Rillet’s most important growth functions.

You’ll own our strategy across the Big 4, top accounting firms, mid-market boutiques, and the long-tail of high value Fractional CFOs  — building relationships that translate into pipeline, revenue, and long-term market advantage.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll own the number, lead and inspire a growing team, and represent Rillet with senior executives across the industry. You will orchestrate the partnerships engine, while still stepping in to close a partner, create the pitch, or solve what is not working. You will also be responsible for working cross-functionally with leadership across Sales, Solutions, Marketing, Customer Success, and Rillet’s PE Partnerships team to build the infrastructure that drives outcomes at scale.

We’re looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. Our hybrid schedule brings the team together in person on Tuesdays through Thursdays. This role requires significant travel.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own channel revenue. Build the strategy, pipeline, and operating cadence to grow the team’s revenue.

 - Build the infrastructure. Effectively enable partner cross-sell, up-level Rillet’s sales process to work productively with partners, create repeatable go-to-market motions, and build & manage an engaging events calendar.

 - Identify & execute on strategic initiatives. Work with partner on longer-term bets and ancillary opportunities beyond near-term revenue generation.

 - Lead and scale the team. Hire, coach, inspire, and raise the bar for a high-performing partnerships organization.

 - Represent Rillet at the highest levels. Build credibility with C-suite executives, senior partners, and industry leaders and become a trusted ambassador for Rillet.

 - Turn relationships into outcomes. Create repeatable programs that generate pipeline, customers, and strategic value — not just logos or introductions.

 - Raise the communication bar. Build exceptional presentations, pitches, and partner materials, and coach the team to do the same.

 - Lead across Rillet. Partner closely with every function at Rillet to make the team successful.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience, ideally with an analytical foundation (accounting, MBB consulting, IB/PE experience). Experience working with advisory firms strongly preferred

 - You have led and scaled a strategic partnerships, or channel function with clear accountability for revenue.

 - You have managed and developed strong teams, and people want to work for you, learn from you, and follow your leadership.

 - You are exceptionally execution oriented – move fast, make decisions with incomplete information, run through walls, and simply get things done. You are allergic to analysis paralysis

 - You have exceptional executive presence and can build credibility with senior leaders across complex, sophisticated organizations.

 - You are a relentless, low-ego builder who thrives in white space and is comfortable doing the work yourself before there is a playbook around you.

 - You move quickly and adapt easily without losing your point of view or focus on the number.

 - You have a team mindset. Rillet is a highly collaborative company with complex go-to-market and delivery operations. You need others on your side.

 - Experience with events, conferences, and ecosystem-building is a strong plus.



The expected OTE range for this role is $260,000–$300,000 in New York City and San Francisco. Final compensation within this range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com http://rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.




LIFE AT RILLET

 - Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

 - Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

 - Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

 - Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Concept Reply, part of the Reply Network, is a leader in IoT solutions. We support and advise our customers in Automotive, Manufacturing, Smart Infrastructure and beyond in all aspects of Internet of Things (IoT) and Cloud Computing. From designing and developing customized IoT solutions to implementing and managing them seamlessly, Concept Reply helps customers unlock the potential of IoT.   The Industry 4.0 Engineer will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of smart manufacturing systems and processes. This role focuses on integrating advanced technologies such as IoT, automation, big data analytics, artificial intelligence, and cyber-physical systems to enhance operational efficiency, productivity, and innovation. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical background and a passion for digital transformation.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Industry 4.0 solutions, including IoT devices, automation systems, and digital twins, to optimize manufacturing processes
  • Develop and deploy data analytics platforms to monitor real-time performance, predict maintenance needs, and improve decision-making
  • Analyze existing processes and recommend improvements using Industry 4.0 technologies to reduce waste and increase efficiency
  • Work with AI, IT, operations, and engineering teams to align Industry 4.0 initiatives with business goals
  • Provide training to staff on new systems and technologies, ensuring smooth adoption and operation
  • Stay updated on emerging Industry 4.0 trends and technologies to drive continuous improvement

    • Minimum Requirements

  • US citizen or green card holder per client requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of experience in manufacturing, automation, or industrial engineering, with at least 2 years focused on Industry 4.0 technologies
  • Proficiency in IoT platforms (e.g., MQTT, OPC UA), UNS, and industrial communication protocols
  • Experience with automation tools (e.g., PLC programming, HMI, MES, SCADA systems)
  • Knowledge of data analytics tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and machine learning frameworks
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Snowflake) and digital twin technologies
  • Understanding of cybersecurity principles for industrial systems

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Certification in Industry 4.0, IoT, Ignition Core/Gold, or AWS Cloud Practitioner
  • Experience with manufacturing in industrial applications
    • About Reply   Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.   Reply is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to provide equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you need assistance and reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, email us at jobusa@reply.com. Visit our website at www.reply.com to learn more about our open roles.

Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform.


THE ROLE

Functionally the Vault is a high-end warehouse with sophisticated internal software and a marketplace bolted directly to it.

This is a builder seat, not a product management seat. You own the Vault from arrival to exit: ingest SLAs, intake and routing, exception handling and QC, outtake, international shipping, customs, insurance, carrier integrations, and the tooling that runs all of it. And you own it the whole way: you stand in the room and watch the bottleneck, you pull the station data yourself, you write the tool that removes it, you ship it, you watch what P90 does, you keep it or you kill it.

What this role is not: writing PRDs for someone else to implement, running a quarterly roadmap ritual, managing an ops pod, or translating between the warehouse and engineering. If that's the shape of your last five years, this probably isn't the right fit, and we'd rather say so up front than waste your time.

You report directly to the CEO. If you want a CEO in the build with you, this is that. If you want distance from the top, it isn't.

The metric you own: Time-to-Liquidity (median and P90). Supporting KPIs: ingest and outtake SLA adherence, cost per item processed (labor minutes, rework, fully loaded unit cost), throughput per FTE and items per week, error and rework rate, inventory activation rate (vaulted to live to sold), ship-and-decide velocity (tools and changes shipped per week), and Vault-related seller satisfaction.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - The end-to-end lifecycle, in code. Receiving and ingest, processing and routing, exception handling and QC, outtake and customer handoff. Define measurable SLAs at every stage, instrument them yourself so the numbers exist, enforce them, and hunt bottlenecks systematically instead of working around them. The station-level data that tells you where P90 went does not exist yet in the shape you'll need. You build that too.

 - The Vault tooling, built not requested. Queue management, prioritization, labeling, SLA tracking, the exception taxonomy and the software that enforces it. Retool got the operation this far and it is now the ceiling. Replace it with durable software, starting with the version you write yourself and put in front of an ops lead this week. You'll be in Python, Postgres, and AWS, with React and TypeScript for the surfaces the vault team actually touches.

 - International shipping and logistics. Customs, insurance, labeling, carrier integrations. Cross-border is where delay and risk concentrate. Make it fast and boring, wire it into the SLA and liquidity picture, and put document models on the paperwork so outtake stops being a human transcription step.

 - Inventory activation and liquidity. Shrink the distance between "in vault" and "live on marketplace." Find where activation stalls by item tier, seller segment, and station, then build the product that closes it. Partner with Pricing, Auctions, CX, and Risk so vaulted inventory gets listed and monetized quickly.

 - Quality, reliability, and trust. Error rates, rework, and the exception taxonomy are yours. A mis-handled high-value item isn't a ticket. It's someone's money and someone's trust, and the control that catches it is software you wrote.

 - The bets and the trade-offs. A short quarterly plan tied to time-to-liquidity, cost per item, and activation rate, and a weekly record of what actually shipped. Who We Are
EDO is the TV outcomes company. Our leading measurement platform connects convergent TV airings to the ad-driven consumer behaviors most predictive of future sales. EDO empowers the advertising industry to maximize media impact, optimize creative performance, and know the fair value of every impression — across linear and streaming for an increasingly programmatic world. By combining immediate engagement signals with world-class decision science and vertical AI, EDO equips industry leaders with syndicated, investment-grade data that aligns media to business results — with detailed competitive, category, and historical insights. Leading brands, agencies, networks, streamers, and studios trust EDO’s TV intelligence to know what works.
EDO is headquartered in New York City and Los Angeles with an office space in San Francisco.
We recognize the benefits of hybrid working, and want to create the best balance to ensure we can continue working together effectively.  For those who reside full-time in NYC, SF, or LA: we have a hybrid work policy of three days in the office and two remote work days.
To learn more about the work we do at EDO, please visit EDO Press.
The Role
As a Senior Full Stack Engineer at EDO, you will write software that presents our world-class data to our clients.  You will use your full-stack skills to develop clear, intuitive, and actionable reports.  You will join an optimistic and creative team of problem-solvers.  You will partner with our Media Analytics and Data Science teams to present our clients with the insights they need to make informed and effective advertising decisions.
What You Will Do

Collaborate with our product teams to implement data exploration and visualization features in our client application.
Scale our application, associated APIs, and backend processes related to our automated reporting tools.
Work with our backend teams to integrate performance enhancements and new data into our platform.
Work on a small team and take ownership of high-impact projects.
Work in a fast-paced environment with continuous deployment and rapid product iteration..
Help define the future of media and advertising through the innovative use of data and technology.
Have direct impact on product growth at a nimble Series B-stage company.

What We Are Looking For

BS / MS in Computer Science or a related technical field.
5+ years of experience in product-focused full-stack software engineering, with a track record of delivering end-to-end features at scale.
A high-agency self-starter who thrives in high-ambiguity environments. You have a proven ability to navigate the shifting priorities of a fast-growing startup without losing momentum.
Versatility, i.e., the ability and willingness to wear multiple hats and switch gears frequently.
Ability to build products quickly and efficiently.
Deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals.
We believe that strong engineers can learn any stack, but we currently use:

Front-end: React, Typescript, CSS
Backend: Ruby on Rails
Database: MySQL, Snowflake
Infrastructure: AWS


Compensation and Benefits
EDO offers a competitive compensation package. Components of compensation include:

Mid-stage equity and competitive salary
Flexible Time Off
Medical, dental and vision coverage: EDO provides full coverage for individual medical plans and partial coverage for dependent or family plans.
401(k) plan, FSA, HSA
Commuter Benefits
When in an office, employee meals, snacks, and more

In compliance with New York and California Pay Transparency Law, the salary range for this position is $150,000-$180,000 annually plus equity. We note the salary information as a general guideline only, as actual compensation may vary from posting. We will consider various factors to determine the offer for this role, including the scope and responsibilities of the position, relevant work experience, key skills, training, and business considerations.

ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DECISION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Automate the delivery of gigawatts. Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand.

 - Forward-deploy beside the experts. Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit.

 - Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last. Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Build the fleet health system: real-time telemetry and tiered healthchecks on every machine across Kubernetes and bare metal, rolled into one API the whole company trusts to answer "is this machine healthy," with alarms correlated into incidents that reach on-call with a drafted probable cause.

 - Turn repair and RMA into generated work: one tracked flow from failure detection through triage, parts, vendor return, and return to service, where failure thresholds route machines to repair automatically, each production engineer's shift todo list is generated for them, and time to return to service is a number the system reports.

 - Ship hardware qualification as software: burn-in, performance baselining, and new hardware validation composed into rack-level workflows, so bringing thousands of accelerators online is a repeatable run and every machine enters production with its acceptance evidence attached in the graph.

 - Run the facility on the same system as the fleet: the maintenance system for lockout tagout and work orders is live at one site and rolls out to two more, every asset register loads before the first external audit this fall, and the legacy datacenter inventory retires before the next building energizes. LLR Partners is seeking a Managing Director of Go-to-Market (“GTM”) to join the leadership team of its Value Creation Team. The Managing Director will report to the Senior Managing Director of Value Creation and will be accountable for helping LLR portfolio of companies accelerate revenue growth, improve commercial productivity, and build scalable go-to-market capabilities.
The ideal candidate will be a proven, repeat Chief Revenue Officer or equivalent senior commercial executive with significant experience scaling SaaS and technology-enabled software businesses. The candidate will bring broad expertise across sales, revenue operations, marketing, customer success, pricing, channels, and commercial strategy, along with the judgment and interpersonal skills required to influence management teams and deal teams without formal authority.
This is a player-coach role. The Managing Director will personally lead high-impact portfolio engagements while managing and developing a team of GTM professionals. The individual will rapidly diagnose the commercial issues and opportunities most material to enterprise value, translate those insights into practical action plans, and stay engaged through execution and measurable results. The Managing Director will be expected to bring or develop practical GTM playbooks, tools, benchmarks, and best practices that can be adapted and deployed across multiple portfolio companies to drive repeatable impact.
The individual will also coordinate closely with the other functional leaders within the Value Creation Team to ensure an integrated approach to portfolio support.
Prior experience in a private equity operating, portfolio support, or value-creation role—particularly at a firm investing in technology companies of similar size—is highly desirable.
Key Responsibilities
Portfolio Value Creation

Partner with portfolio company CEOs and executive teams to assess GTM performance, identify opportunities, and develop actionable improvement plans.
Lead engagements across sales effectiveness, revenue operations, marketing, customer success, pricing, packaging, channel strategy, and commercial organization design.
Establish clear objectives, milestones, and measurable outcomes for each engagement.
Help companies build scalable, data-driven GTM capabilities and translate strategy into measurable revenue and EBITDA impact.
Develop and deploy repeatable GTM playbooks, tools, benchmarks, and training across the portfolio, including resources for sales management, forecasting, pipeline generation, pricing, retention, expansion, and organization design.

GTM Investment Diligence

Support investment opportunities by evaluating the quality, scalability, and sustainability of a company’s GTM model.
Assess pipeline, forecasting, bookings, customer acquisition, retention, expansion, productivity, compensation, organization structure, marketing effectiveness, and customer success.
Identify commercial upside, risks, required investments, and post-close priorities.
Manage third-party diligence firms, consultants, data providers, and other relevant market resources, and communicate findings clearly to deal teams.

AI and Emerging GTM Technologies

Maintain a current understanding of AI developments and their implications for SaaS and technology-enabled businesses.
Identify and help implement practical AI applications across sales, revenue operations, marketing, customer success, forecasting, enablement, and customer engagement.
Evaluate AI use cases, providers, implementation requirements, risks, and expected returns, incorporating relevant applications into GTM playbooks.

Team Leadership and Collaboration

Manage, mentor, and develop GTM team members while allocating resources across multiple engagements based on expected portfolio impact.
Coordinate GTM initiatives with the Value Creation Team’s other functional areas, including finance, operations, product, technology, talent, and data/analytics.
Contribute to the broader strategy and operating model of the Value Creation Team and share insights, tools, benchmarks, and best practices across the portfolio.

Stakeholder Communication

Build trusted relationships with LLR partners, deal professionals, portfolio company leaders, and external advisors.
Communicate complex commercial issues and recommendations in a concise, practical, and actionable manner.
Present effectively to both investment and operating audiences while demonstrating sound judgment, humility, and respect for management teams.

Candidate Qualifications

Former CRO, Chief Revenue Officer, or equivalent senior commercial executive at multiple SaaS or technology-enabled software companies.
Demonstrated success scaling revenue, improving sales productivity, increasing customer retention and expansion, and building high-performing GTM organizations.
Experience working with private equity-backed companies strongly preferred.
Prior experience in a private equity operating, portfolio operations, or value-creation role is a plus.
Experience supporting commercial or GTM investment diligence, including familiarity with relevant diligence firms, consultants, data sources, and market resources.
Demonstrated understanding of current AI capabilities and practical applications within the GTM function.
Experience managing, coaching, and developing high-performing teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and engagements while remaining focused on measurable portfolio impact.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
Strong analytical judgment and business acumen, with the ability to move effectively between strategic issues and detailed execution.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant professional experience is a plus.

Leadership Profile
The successful candidate will be:

Low ego, collaborative, and highly team-oriented.
Comfortable influencing without authority and working through management teams.
Equally effective as a strategic advisor and hands-on operator.
High in emotional intelligence, judgment, curiosity, and personal accountability.
Commercially rigorous, pragmatic, and focused on results.
Able to build trust quickly with CEOs, executives, investment professionals, and team members.
Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and highly collaborative environment.
Motivated by helping companies and people perform at their best.
 

LLR Partners is a lower middle market private equity firm focused on investing in software and tech-enabled companies within the knowledge economy. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Philadelphia, LLR has raised over $7.5 billion across seven funds and has partnered with over 130 companies. LLR believes in creating value through partnership by providing flexible capital, strategic guidance and sector insight to help companies grow every day.
LLR Partners is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hr@llrpartners.com

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Adyen’s Partner Ecosystem is one of our fastest-growing distribution channels, and a critical path to scalably bring the best of Adyen to merchants. Through partnerships with major commerce, POS, enterprise software, and cloud platforms (such as Adobe Commerce, Salesforce, Oracle, and SAP), Adyen powers billions of dollars in global transaction volume.
We need a Product Manager to bring a cohesive vision to how we approach the Partner Ecosystem – what does a successful Partner Ecosystem look like? What are the critical Partner journeys we need to unlock and optimize? What tooling, data, and interfaces do we need to enable success? We’ve gotten this far with groups of systems that have organically grown over time – now we need you to bring a vision that helps us scale to the next level.
Working with key commercial, marketing, go-to-market, and technical delivery stakeholders, you will identify systemic friction points across partner onboarding, integration certification, ecosystem observability, and day-to-day partner operations and integrations. You will build and scale internal applications, automation frameworks, and data platforms that empower our global teams to scale partner integrations effortlessly and reliably.
What You'll Do

Define the Product Vision & Roadmap: Own the end-to-end product strategy for internal partner tooling, developer infrastructure, and operational workflows. Translate complex cross-functional challenges into clear product roadmaps with measurable business outcomes.
Build High-Impact Internal Platforms: Design and deliver internal tools and services—such as integration health monitoring, automated regression and compliance testing suites, partner certification portals, and self-service analytics platforms.
Eliminate Operational Overhead: Work closely with Partner Solutions Engineering to identify manual, repetitive operational bottlenecks in partner onboarding and integration maintenance. Drive automation and self-service workflows that systematically grind down operational toil.
Pioneer AI & Intelligent Automation: Champion the adoption of intelligent agents, LLM-powered workflows, and automated triage systems to accelerate partner enablement, technical inquiries, and documentation discovery.
Enhance Ecosystem Observability: Partner with data and core engineering teams to establish single-source-of-truth observability across global partner integrations, empowering internal teams to monitor transaction health, payment method performance, and authorization optimization opportunities.

Company Summary: Medici is a modern Executive Health Center and technology company focused on revolutionizing the healthcare experience. At our flagship clinic, we deliver premium, prevention-first executive health exams powered by advanced diagnostics and AI-driven insights. Our mission is to create a world where proactive, deeply personal care is accessible to all—through both a luxury in-clinic experience and transformative technology.   About the Role: We are seeking a hands-on, AI-forward Financial Controller who will play a critical role in managing and strengthening the financial operations that support our next stage of growth. This is not a traditional back-office accounting role.

The Financial Controller will own the day-to-day financial operations of the company while actively leveraging AI, automation, and modern financial tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, reporting, and financial controls. This individual should be excited about identifying processes that can be automated or AI-assisted and implementing smarter, more scalable ways of working.

The ideal candidate combines a strong foundation in finance and accounting with a technology-forward mindset, thrives in a growing company environment, enjoys solving operational challenges, and takes full ownership of the financial health of the organization.

Location & Schedule

This is a hybrid role requiring on-site attendance at our San Antonio clinic two days per week and its Austin clinic one day per month. 

Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, and paid time off. Team members also enjoy access to unique perks such as discounts on IV therapy and M-Sculpt sessions, free onsite yoga, and catered healthy lunches.  

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the day-to-day accounting operations across multiple Medici entities.

  • Manage accounts receivable, including membership billing, service invoicing, payment reconciliation, collections, and account maintenance.

  • Ensure all recurring membership and service invoices are generated accurately and on time.

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable billing and payment tracking processes that ensure accurate invoicing, timely collections, and clear visibility into customer payment status.

  • Leverage AI, automation, and modern financial technology to streamline accounting and finance workflows, improve accuracy, reduce manual processes, and strengthen financial controls.

  • Proactively identify opportunities across accounts receivable, accounts payable, reconciliation, reporting, forecasting, and other financial processes that can be automated or AI-assisted.

  • Evaluate and implement tools, workflows, and process improvements that create a more scalable and technology-enabled finance function.

  • Manage accounts payable, including vendor payments, contractor payments, employee reimbursements, expense review, and oversight of Bill.com workflows and approvals.

  • Maintain accurate financial records and oversee all activity within QuickBooks.

  • Lead month-end and year-end close processes, including reconciliations and financial reporting.

  • Prepare monthly financial statements and provide reporting to leadership.

  • Monitor cash flow and support budgeting and forecasting activities.

  • Coordinate payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate payments for employees and international contractors.

  • Partner with external accountants, auditors, and tax advisors as needed.

  • Develop and improve financial processes, controls, billing workflows, and reporting procedures to support company growth.

  • Work closely with Operations, Care Concierge, and Leadership teams to ensure accurate billing, reporting, and financial management across the organization.

  • Identify process gaps, resolve financial discrepancies, and proactively improve operational efficiency.

    • Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI, automation, or technology to improve finance and accounting processes, with the ability to identify opportunities to automate workflows, increase efficiency, improve accuracy, and strengthen financial controls.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of progressive accounting, finance, or financial operations experience.

  • Strong foundation in accounting principles, financial reporting, reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial controls.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to improve processes and build scalable financial workflows.

  • Experience working with accounting and financial management systems; QuickBooks experience preferred.

  • Experience with accounts payable and payment platforms such as Bill.com or similar systems preferred.

  • Experience with multi-entity financial operations, recurring revenue, memberships, subscriptions, or healthcare billing preferred.

  • CPA or similar professional accounting designation preferred, but not required.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of outcomes, and thrive in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment.

  • Curiosity and willingness to continuously evaluate emerging AI and financial technologies that can improve how the finance function operates.

    • Our Culture

  • Medici is a high-performing team that genuinely enjoys working together. We care deeply about our mission and about each other. We value personal ownership, strong communication, and supporting one another’s growth. Health and wellness are part of our culture—both professionally and personally. Team gatherings have included yoga and sound bath sessions, trying new fitness classes together,playing pickleball and bowling together, and sharing farm-to-table dinners. We’re ambitious and driven, but we also believe in balance, connection, and building a company we’re proud of. We’re a high-trust team. Leadership is supportive and available, but we don’t micromanage—this role requires strong judgment, follow-through, and comfort working independently.
  • We’re also values-driven, and faith is important to our CEO and present in our culture; we welcome people of all backgrounds who align with how we work.

Hear from our CEO, Guillaume de Zwirek, about why we are standing at the edge of the biggest technological shift in healthcare’s history!

Our award-winning culture: Our award-winning culture: Since founding in 2015, Artera has consistently been recognized for its innovative technology, business growth, and named a top place to work. Examples of these accolades include: Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024); Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025); Built In Best Companies to Work For (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026). Artera has also been recognized by Forbes as one of “America’s Best Startup Employers,” Newsweek as one of the “World’s Best Digital Health Companies,” and named one of the top “44 Startups to Bet your Career on in 2024” by Business Insider.   Applicants must be currently authorized and have the ability to provide proof of full-time, long-term authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers now or in the future.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Artera is hiring an AI Builder to build the agentic systems that deliver exceptional patient experiences for our customers — scheduling, referral coordination, medication refills, billing, payment estimation and more. 

You'll be a fully contributing builder inside a customer-facing squad bringing AI-native fluency in delivering end-to-end on your customers’ needs — owning initiatives from customer discovery through production operation, onboarding new customers onto what you build, and shipping enhancements that keep pace with the technical possibilities  for a named subset of our provider customers. Your creativity should be boundless, your desire to deliver world class solutions unmatched, and your initiative and accountability to those outcomes as a new bar for our customers they themselves aspire to. 

At this level, you'll own customer outcomes independently with moderate supervision, bringing the curiosity of a product manager, the discipline of a project manager, and the agentic fluency of an engineer to your work. You'll develop real subject-matter expertise and long term relationships with senior healthcare executives, and internally teach and support newer builders and experiment and advocate for novel agentic techniques that make every Artera customer even more successful. 

Responsibilities

  • Ownership: Own end-to-end delivery and realized outcomes for named customers. Represent Artera credibly in customer conversations, and raise the bar on the customer solutions the squad ships.

  • Strategy: Identify customer pain and create a roadmap for solving their problems.

  • Program Management: Align stakeholders, connect necessary data pipelines, and manage fast and painless onboarding onto our solutions.

  • Agentic Development: Build novel solutions for named customers; translate their operational reality into technical solutions that you yourself architect and code with our internal agentic systems.

  • Continuous Improvement: Instrument, monitor, and improve the reliability of what you ship; create enhancements based on what production actually tells you; participate in on-call where applicable.

  • AI-native: your work across all dimensions will be inherently reliant on  AI-native tools primarily using the CLI; which means you will own a greater breadth and volume of responsibility than a typical technologist.

  • Domain Expertise: Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise in your customer segments (e.g. primary care, community health, orthopedics) and integration surface (e.g., scheduling, referrals, patient messaging, EHR/CCaaS).

  • Mentorship: Mentor and onboard newer builders; review their work with a mindset for raising the bar on agentic techniques and customer orientation.

  • Leadership: Contribute to squad-level prioritization and planning in partnership with the Head of Segment.

    • Requirements

  • 2 - 5 years of professional software engineering, data science, machine learning, product management, product design, or technical project management experience, or equivalent demonstrated output.

  • Demonstrated AI-native fluency with measurable leverage — ability to produce output on par with multiple traditional engineers using AI-native tools (e.g., Claude Code in the terminal) as the primary working environment; ability to learn new technology quickly 

  • Track record of shipping solutions end-to-end that ran reliably in production, including the enhancements that followed.

  • Ability to work directly and productively with customers — onboarding them, owning the relationship, and translating customer conversations into technical decisions.

  • Curiosity of a product manager and discipline of a project manager: asks "why" before "how," scopes and sequences work, communicates status, and lands the work.

  • Written and verbal communication sufficient to present complicated concepts to teammates, managers, and customers with the appropriate level of detail.

  • Demonstrated ability to teach and support less senior teammates, and to raise the bar on the solutions the squad delivers to customers.

    • Bonus

  • Prior experience in healthcare technology, digital health, or patient-facing products.

  • Hands-on experience building production agentic systems, RAG pipelines, or MCP-based tool integrations.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA, HITRUST, or FedRAMP compliance considerations in builds.

  • Experience with EHR integrations (Epic, athena, eClinicalWorks, NextGen) or call center / CCaaS integrations.

  • Experience writing evals and quality benchmarks for LLM-driven systems.

    • This role supports a federal-facing product and is considered essential to secure operations. Candidates must meet eligibility for a government background check and comply with organizational security policies and federal data protection standards. The position includes responsibilities related to secure access, incident response, and operational continuity. Ongoing training and adherence to compliance requirements will be required.

    OUR APPROACH TO WORK LOCATION

    At Artera, we believe the best work happens when people are truly connected. Our AI services model has shown what’s possible when small, focused teams move fast together — the speed of collaboration, pace of career growth, and quality of what we build can become stronger when teams share space. As we grow, we want every new teammate to feel part of an in-person community from day one.

    That’s why we are focusing our U.S. hiring in three cities, where we are investing in offices and building strong local teams:

    • Santa Barbara, CA (Our HQ)
    • Seattle, WA
    • Kansas City, KS/MO

    Unless a role’s posting states otherwise, new U.S. roles are based in one of these three cities, and candidates should reside in (or be willing to relocate to) one of these areas. Each location follows an in-person schedule that reflects how our local teams work best; we’ll walk you through what to expect for your specific role and city during the interview process.

    Focusing on offices and hiring in a few locations, rather than spreading thin across many cities, lets us invest deeply in each one so every team has real community, mentorship, and momentum in person.

    WORKING AT ARTERA 

    Company benefits - Full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short-term & long-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k) and more!  Career development - Manager development resources, employee development funds Generous time off - Company holidays, Winter & Summer break, and flexible time off Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) - We believe that everyone should belong at their workplace. Our ERGs are available for identifying employees or allies to join.   

    EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY (EEO) STATEMENT

    Artera is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fair and equitable hiring practices. All hiring decisions at Artera are based on strategic business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. All candidates are considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetics, protected veteran status, or any other protected status.

    • Affirmative Action Plan: To review our company’s Affirmative Action Notice, please click here to view our Affirmative Action Notice.

    • Know Your Rights: To view your rights as an applicant under federal equal employment opportunity laws, please view the official EEOC poster: Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.

    In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

    Artera is committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment; Artera will not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind. Artera provides reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees in compliance with state and federal laws. If you need an accommodation, please reach out to hr@artera.io.

     

    DATA PRIVACY

    Artera values your privacy. By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal information provided in conjunction with your application. For more information please refer to our Privacy Policy.  

    SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

    All employees are responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the organization’s systems and data, including safeguarding Artera’s sensitive information such as, Personal identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI). Those with specific security or privacy responsibilities must ensure compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and applicable standards and frameworks by implementing safeguards, monitoring for threats, reporting incidents, and addressing data handling risks or breaches.

ABOUT ONEPAY

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

 - Ready to run

 - Hungry and driven by urgency

 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

 - Comfortable operating in motion




ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE DESIGN TEAM

Experience Design at OnePay shapes how millions of people interact with their money. The product touches saving, spending, borrowing, and growing wealth – often for people the traditional financial system has underserved. That weight raises the bar on what we ship and how we ship it.

We’re a small, senior team with roots at Apple, Meta, Ford, Airbnb, and leading fintechs – low ego, high craft, and genuinely collaborative. AI is a baseline part of how we work, not a future we’re talking about.




THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Design Engineer to help define what modern design-to-code looks like at OnePay. This is a first-class engineering role with design fluency. You’ll generate production-ready components directly, use AI coding tools aggressively, and help push the team past traditional spec-based handoff. You’re not executing the current model – you’re shaping what comes next.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - You ship in code. Figma is part of how you communicate, but you’re most fluent in the codebase. You generate production-ready work, not just specs.

 - You’re AI-native at production velocity. Cursor, Claude Code, v0, similar tools – they’re already how you move. You ship more in a day than most teams do in a week.

 - You’re rethinking handoff. The traditional model is breaking down, and you’re excited to define what replaces it.

 - You translate fluently. You speak both languages. Designers trust you, engineers trust you, and you make the gap between them disappear.

 - You sweat the implementation. A two-pixel drift in production matters to you. So does a token that doesn’t quite map. You catch what others miss.

 - You operate in motion. Process is fluid here, and you help shape it as you ship.




TOOLS WE USE

We use Node and TypeScript on the server, leveraging the NestJS framework within a microservice-oriented architecture running on Kubernetes and AWS. On the client side, we build and ship product features for iOS, Android, and web platforms using React Native. We also embrace AI-assisted development, so engineers have their choice of Claude Code or Cursor to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.




YOU BRING

 - Fluency in both Figma and code (React Native or React).

 - Active use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, v0, or similar) at production velocity.

 - Fluency in design tokens, component architecture, and how design systems map to code.

 - Experience shipping on cross-functional teams where design and engineering overlap.

 - Strong communication across both disciplines.

 - A track record of operating in fluid environments and helping define how teams work.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

 - 401(k) plan with company match

 - Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact




STANDARD INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

 - AI-assisted initial screen

 - Interview with Talent Partner

 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

 - Team Interview

 - Executive Interview

 - Offer!




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

Job Title: Vice President, Product Management
Department: Product Development 
About the Role: Unite Us is seeking a Vice President, Product Management to lead the product organization responsible for our platform and product suite.
Our customers span government agencies, health systems, health plans, and community-based organizations (CBOs). They rely on Unite Us to identify needs, coordinate services across sectors, manage referrals and cases, and measure impact. Doing that well means building products that work for a caseworker at a small food pantry and a CIO at a national health plan, on the same platform, with the same commitment to privacy and dignity.
You'll help set the product vision and strategy, lead a team of product directors and managers, and own the portfolio from investment decision to measurable outcome. You'll shape how our platform scales: the shared services, identity, interoperability, and data foundations that let many teams ship independently without fragmenting the experience. And you'll bring the discipline that connects every product bet to customer value, financial results, and the people we ultimately serve.
This is a senior leadership role for a builder. If you've architected platforms yourself, led product at scale in a complex healthcare environment, and helped grow a team from good to great, this is a good fit.
What You'll Do:
Product Vision and Strategy

Define and communicate a multi-year product vision and strategy aligned with company goals, customer needs, and the evolving policy landscape for health and community care.
Translate strategy into a clear, prioritized roadmap, and make hard tradeoff decisions with confidence and transparency.
Stay close to customers, frontline users, and market trends, including government programs, value-based care, and reimbursement models for non-medical services.
Identify where AI and advanced analytics can meaningfully improve how needs are identified, how services are coordinated, and how outcomes are measured.
Represent product strategy to the executive team, the board, and key customers and partners.

Portfolio and Investment Management

Own the product portfolio, including investment allocation, initiative sizing, and return on investment across product lines.
Build product intelligence that links initiatives to financials and outcomes, so leaders can see what we're spending, what we're getting, and what to stop.
Run recurring business reviews with executive leadership that hold product, engineering, and business teams accountable to shared outcomes.
Rationalize and consolidate overlapping capabilities to reduce cost, complexity, and security exposure.

Platform, Identity, and Interoperability

Lead the evolution of the Unite Us platform toward configurable, reusable capabilities that let decentralized teams deliver a unified experience.
Champion a secure, scalable identity strategy, including single sign-on (SSO), OAuth and OpenID Connect (OIDC), role-based access control (RBAC), and multi-factor authentication.
Partner with Interoperability Solutions Delivery and Engineering to grow our integration portfolio, including FHIR, SMART on FHIR, HL7, electronic health record (EHR) integrations, and partner APIs.
Ensure products meet regulatory and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, and interoperability rules such as the 21st Century Cures Act.
Build a third-party and partner ecosystem that extends the value of our network.

Product Organization and Leadership

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product directors and product managers, building a culture of empowered, outcome-focused teams.
Establish consistent product practices across teams: discovery, prioritization, outcome measurement, and storytelling about what we've learned and delivered.
Recruit and develop strong product talent, and create clear paths for growth.
Celebrate outcomes, not just output, and make sure wins are shared across the company.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Engineering and Design leadership as a unified product development leadership team.
Work with Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation to understand customer needs, support strategic deals, and ensure what we sell is what we deliver.
Collaborate with Marketing on positioning, launches, and how we tell the story of our products.
Engage directly with customers and partners, including executive stakeholders at health plans, health systems, and government agencies.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

12+ years of experience in product management, solution architecture, or health information technology, with 5+ years leading product teams and product leaders
Led a large, multi-team product portfolio in healthcare, health plans, or health IT, and you can speak to the investment, outcome, and financial results of your decisions
Technical foundation deep enough to go toe-to-toe with architects on platform, identity, and API strategy, ideally because you've been one
Delivered interoperability capabilities in production, such as FHIR APIs, SMART on FHIR applications, or EHR integrations
Built or scaled a platform that lets many independent teams deliver a consistent experience
Understand the regulatory environment for health data, including HIPAA and the 21st Century Cures Act
Introduced product operating practices into an organization and made them stick
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including with executives, boards, and customer leadership
Comfortable presenting to large audiences, and you enjoy teaching and developing others
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ambiguity and competing priorities
Commitment to social impact initiatives and helping underserved communities
Experience serving special populations, such as Medicaid members, foster youth, or people receiving long-term services and supports (LTSS) a plus
Experience with customer identity and access management (CIAM) platforms, such as Ping Identity or Okta a plus
Background in clinical informatics or clinical decision support a plus
Experience applying AI to product operations, portfolio management, or the product itself a plus
Experience in a project-funded organization moving toward a product operating model a plus
Published research, industry conference presentations, or teaching experience in health information technology or health administration a plus
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Public Health, or a related field; master's degree in Health Administration, Public Health, Business, or a related field strongly preferred

Technical Tools:

Product and Roadmapping: Jira, Productboard, Aha!, or similar
Analytics: Sigma, Looker, Tableau, or similar
CRM Tools: Intercom, Jira
Documentation Tools: Confluence, Google Suite
Project Management Tools: Asana
Performance Management Tool: Lattice
Internal Tools: Workday, Zoom, Slack, Workramp

What success looks like:

In your first 90 days: you know our customers, products, and team; you've met key customers and partners; and you've shared an initial assessment of the portfolio and the product organization.
By six months: a clear product vision and roadmap are in place and understood across the company, every major initiative is tied to measurable outcomes and financials, and consistent product practices are running across teams.
By a year: the portfolio is simpler and more focused, the platform lets teams ship faster with less duplication, and we can show measurable improvements in customer outcomes and product-driven revenue.

Our Mission:
Unite Us’ mission is to unlock the potential of every community. Our co-founders started Unite Us in 2013 to serve the people they served with. They witnessed firsthand the barriers and inefficiencies in trying to navigate health and social services, and set out to improve that experience for veterans and their families. Unite Us quickly expanded to serving all people who need connections to care across our country. Through Unite Us’ national network and software, community-based organizations, government agencies, and healthcare organizations are all connected to better collaborate to meet the needs of the individuals in their communities. We drive the collaboration to predict, deliver, and pay for services that impact whole-person health. If you want to do well and do good, join Unite Us.
Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions:

This position is remote, U.S. based. 
This position may require 25% travel
The target pay range for this role is: $225,000-$265,000. This salary range represents our target hiring range for this role. The proposed salary will be dependent on the candidate's skills, experience, and competencies, as well as location.
All team members will be required to pass a background check which includes criminal, employment, and education verification 

Benefits provided by Unite Us:
Medical, Dental, and Vision
We offer insurance to team members and eligible partners and dependents, including unlimited virtual mental health and acute medical visits.
Wellness
Mental health benefits, such as the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness platform subscription, are available to all team members.
Flexible Time Off
Take what you need, including volunteer days and mental health days. We also offer 14 paid, company-wide holidays.Paid Parental Leave
Adoptive parents are included.
Employee Resource Groups
Join our ERGs to connect and engage with colleagues, like Military Veterans
Spending Accounts
We offer tax-advantaged health savings accounts (HSAs), flexible spending accounts (FSAs), and commuter benefits.
401(k) + Employer Match
Enjoy matching, immediate vesting and financial wellness resources
Additional Benefits
Life and AD&D - a company paid benefit, with the option to purchase additional coverage for yourself and your dependents
Disability Coverage
Accident Insurance
Pet Insurance
As part of this work at home job, we will provide you with all the necessary equipment to perform your duties, including a computer, mouse, keyboard as well as other items on our approved list of WFH supplies.
Unite Us is committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive culture, and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and encourage our employees' differences in race, religion, color, national origin, gender, family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, medical conditions, and other characteristics. If you require assistance in applying for open positions due to a disability please email us at peopleops@uniteus.com to request an accommodation.

CREATIVE TECHNOLOGIST (AI DESIGN ENGINEER)

Also known as: Creative Workflow Specialist · AI Workflow Designer




🎨 ABOUT OPENART

OpenArt is a leading AI Creative Platform for visual storytelling, used by millions worldwide. We're building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, images, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We're bringing those tools together into one agentic creative environment: it understands what you mean, orchestrates the right capabilities, and still leaves you in full control of the work. We believe the future of creativity is AI-native, and we're shaping that future.




🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE

We're building tools that expand what's creatively possible — and, increasingly, an agent that does the work: it understands what a creator wants, picks the right models and tools, runs the job, and hands back something they can see, adjust, and finish. For that to hold up in professional production, the agent has to know the work from the inside.

That's where you come in. We need someone who sits between creators and product to turn real pain points in professional workflows into solutions that run and can be proven. If you know professional creative production from the inside and you're used to building your own ideas into interactive prototypes with AI, this might be your seat.

We're not just looking for someone who makes demos. We're looking for someone who finds the problem, researches the workflow, delivers the prototype end to end, makes the case for it, and then hands it to engineering to ship.




🚀 WHY JOIN OPENART

 - Your prototypes become products. What you build won't stop at a demo. Validated prototypes go straight onto the product roadmap and are taken to launch by engineering.

 - Work at the frontier of AI and creativity. You'll be among the first to get hands-on with new models and capabilities, and as a practitioner, you'll decide what shape they take inside creators' workflows — and what the agent should do with them on a creator's behalf.

 - Direct impact on product direction. Your judgment won't sit in a review queue. From identifying problems to validating prototypes, you'll directly shape what OpenArt builds next.

 - Hyper-growth and huge market opportunity. OpenArt is one of the largest AI video generation platforms globally, with millions of monthly active users and partnerships with top model players including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, BytePlus, and Kling.

 - Define where creative tools go next. Generation gets cheaper every month; what creators and clients pay for is finished work. An agent that does the whole job is where the category is heading, and the person who knows production from the inside is the one who decides what it does.




🧩 REQUIREMENTS

 - ndependently takeFluency in professional creative pipelines. Hands-on experience in professional creative production such as advertising, film, or content. You understand every stage from brief to delivery and can pinpoint where the real bottlenecks are.

 - Moves fluidly between design and engineering. AI is your core tool for building. You're proficient with AI coding tools, model APIs, agent frameworks, and lightweight code, and can independently turn concepts into working prototypes fast.

 - End-to-end delivery. You can i work from problem definition and workflow research through interaction design, visual design, and a usable prototype, delivered to a standard professional users can work with directly.

 - Strong product taste. You hold a high bar for craft, polish, and interaction quality, and you know the difference between something that works and something that works well.

 - A body of work that proves it. A portfolio or GitHub showing the tools, prototypes, products, or experiments you've built. We care far more about what you've made than where you've worked.




🌟 NICE TO HAVE

 - Proficiency with professional creative tools. Editing, compositing, motion, or 3D tools. You don't just know how to use them; you know where they fall short on real projects.

 - Background in advertising, film, or content production. You've felt the pressure of professional production firsthand and know what clients and teams actually need before a deadline.

 - Experience at a creative lab, innovation agency, or AI product team. You're comfortable moving through ambiguity and turning new technology into something concrete and usable.

 - You've built with agents. Tool-calling, MCP, skills, or your own automations — anything where the AI did part of the job for you, and you learned where it should and shouldn't be trusted.




🛠 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Identify where workflows break. Embed in the real production work of our in-house creative team and enterprise clients to pinpoint bottlenecks — and the places where an agent doing the work first would change what a team can ship.

 - Teach the agent the job. Turn what you learn into workflows the agent can run end to end — a brief into a set of finished ad variants, one video into ten languages, a winning ad into every placement size — and define what "done to a professional standard" means for each, so what comes back is usable without a second pass.

 - Turn complex generative workflows into intuitive experiences. As models and workflows grow more capable and more complex, decide what the agent should simply handle and where a professional needs to step in to see, adjust, and finish — so creators stay in control of the work instead of waiting on a black box.

 - Rapidly prototype new concepts. Use AI tools, Figma, lightweight code, and APIs to explore interaction patterns and validate ideas, taking them from early concept to polished interface, including motion, transitions, and micro-interactions.

 - Define what each prototype needs to prove. Before each prototype, be clear on the hypothesis it's testing. After, assess what was learned and make a clear call: scale, iterate, or stop.

 - Drive from concept to launch. Work closely with product, model, and engineering teams to turn validated prototypes into shipped features, and build up reusable components and interaction patterns along the way, so the next workflow reaches creators faster.




💰 COMPENSATION

 - Competitive TC including base salary, bonus, and equity (based on experience).

 - Meaningful equity ownership in what you build.




🌍 WORK SETUP

 - San Carlos, CA (full-time, on-site or hybrid)

 - Visa sponsorship available
